messages: The master blacksmith of #m10004000#, #p504#, seems to be looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.

The master blacksmith of #m10004000#, #p504#, is giving me a test to see if I'm fit to become his apprentice. He said that a true blacksmith must have the required amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to defeat the monsters around #m10004000# and bring back the raw ore they drop.
I passed the test given by #p504#, the master blacksmith of #m10004000#. Does this mean I can become a true blacksmith in Maple World?
name: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
